theorem ccStepB_removeVoter (V : GSet w64) (m : CCV1M) (Hty : m.type = W32 1) (h0 : m.nodeId ≠ W64
    0) (hV : m.nodeId ∈ V) (hne : GMap.delete m.nodeId V ≠ ∅) (Hsz : GMap.size V < 2 ^ 62) : ccStepB
    (ccV2Of (CCMsg.v1 m)) (cfgState V ∅) = some (cfgState (GMap.delete m.nodeId V) ∅)

theorem fold_adjacent (dec : CCDec) (l : List EntryM) (i j : Nat) (s0 si sj : CCState) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hc : confCount (List.take j l) ≤ confCount (List.take i l) + 1) (h0 : CfgOk s0) (hi : cfgFold
    dec s0 (List.take i l) = some si) (hj : cfgFold dec s0 (List.take j l) = some sj) : QOverlap
    si.cfg sj.cfg

theorem ccApplyM_overlap {t : raftpb.ConfChangeTransition} {ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM} {s s' :
    CCState} (h : ccApplyM t ccs s = some s') (hs : CfgOk s) (hb : GMap.size s'.cfg.ids < 2 ^ 62) :
    QOverlap s.cfg s'.cfg ∧ CfgOk s'

def CCDec : Type :=
  List EntryM → EntryM → Option CCOp

def CfgOk (s : CCState) : Prop :=
  CfgInv s ∧ s.cfg.incoming ≠ ∅ ∧ GMap.size s.cfg.ids < 2 ^ 62

theorem cfgFold_ok {dec : CCDec} {s s' : CCState} {l : List EntryM} (h : cfgFold dec s l = some s')
    (hs : CfgOk s) : CfgOk s'

theorem enterJointM_overlap {al : Bool} {ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM} {s s' : CCState} (h :
    enterJointM al ccs s = some s') (hs : CfgOk s) (hb : GMap.size s'.cfg.ids < 2 ^ 62) : QOverlap
    s.cfg s'.cfg ∧ CfgOk s'

theorem leaveJointM_overlap {s s' : CCState} (h : leaveJointM s = some s') (hs : CfgOk s) (hb :
    GMap.size s'.cfg.ids < 2 ^ 62) : QOverlap s.cfg s'.cfg ∧ CfgOk s'

theorem cfgOk_cfgState (V : GSet w64) (hne : V ≠ ∅) (Hsz : GMap.size V < 2 ^ 62) : CfgOk (cfgState V
    ∅)

def CCOp : Type :=
  raftpb.ConfChangeTransition × List ConfChangeSingleM

def ccStepB (op : CCOp) (s : CCState) : Option CCState :=
  (ccApplyM op.fst op.snd s).bind fun s' => if GMap.size s'.cfg.ids < 2 ^ 62 then some s' else none

theorem cfgFoldFrom_append (dec : CCDec) (pre : List EntryM) (s : CCState) (l1 l2 : List EntryM) :
    cfgFoldFrom dec pre s (l1 ++ l2) = (cfgFoldFrom dec pre s l1).bind fun s' => cfgFoldFrom dec
    (pre ++ l1) s' l2

theorem maj_symdiff_overlap (l r q1 q2 : GSet w64) (hd : symdiffN l r ≤ 1) (h1 : IsQuorum l q1) (h2
    : IsQuorum r q2) : ∃ x, x ∈ q1 ∧ x ∈ q2

theorem ccStepB_removeAbsent (V : GSet w64) (m : CCV1M) (Hty : m.type = W32 1) (h0 : m.nodeId ≠ W64
    0) (hV : ¬m.nodeId ∈ V) (hne : V ≠ ∅) (Hsz : GMap.size V < 2 ^ 62) : ccStepB (ccV2Of (CCMsg.v1
    m)) (cfgState V ∅) = some (cfgState V ∅)

theorem simpleM_overlap {ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM} {s s' : CCState} (h : simpleM ccs s = some
    s') (hs : CfgOk s) (hb : GMap.size s'.cfg.ids < 2 ^ 62) : QOverlap s.cfg s'.cfg ∧ CfgOk s'

theorem not_symdiffTooBig {l r : GSet w64} (hb : symdiffN l r < 2 ^ 63) (h : ¬SymdiffTooBig l r) :
    symdiffN l r ≤ 1

theorem gset_size_inter_diff (l r : GSet w64) : GMap.size l = (l ∩ r).size + (l \ r).size

def cfgFold (dec : CCDec) (s : CCState) (l : List EntryM) : Option CCState :=
  cfgFoldFrom dec [] s l

theorem ccApplyM_single_simple (c : ConfChangeSingleM) (s : CCState) : ccApplyM (W32 0) [c] s =
    simpleM [c] s

theorem cfgState_empty_ids (V : GSet w64) : (cfgState V ∅).cfg.ids = V

theorem cfgFoldFrom.eq_def (dec : CCDec) (pre : List EntryM) (s : CCState) (x✝ : List EntryM) :
    cfgFoldFrom dec pre s x✝ = match x✝ with | [] => some s | e :: es => (entStep dec pre s e).bind
    fun s' => cfgFoldFrom dec (pre ++ [e]) s' es

theorem cfgFoldFrom_zero (dec : CCDec) (pre : List EntryM) (s : CCState) (l : List EntryM) (h :
    confCount l = 0) : cfgFoldFrom dec pre s l = some s

theorem size_incoming_le (c : CfgM) : GMap.size c.incoming ≤ GMap.size c.ids

theorem cfgFold_append (dec : CCDec) (s : CCState) (l1 l2 : List EntryM) : cfgFold dec s (l1 ++ l2)
    = (cfgFold dec s l1).bind fun s' => cfgFoldFrom dec l1 s' l2

theorem applyM_incoming {ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM} {s s' : CCState} (h : applyM ccs s = some s')
    : s'.cfg.incoming ≠ ∅

def cfgFoldFrom (dec : CCDec) (pre : List EntryM) (s : CCState) : List EntryM → Option CCState :=
  List.brecOn (motive := fun x => List EntryM → CCState → Option CCState) x✝ (cfgFoldFrom._f dec) pre s

def entStep (dec : CCDec) (pre : List EntryM) (s : CCState) (e : EntryM) : Option CCState :=
  if IsConfEnt e then (dec pre e).bind fun op => ccStepB op s else some s

theorem entStep_overlap {dec : CCDec} {pre : List EntryM} {s s' : CCState} {e : EntryM} (h : entStep
    dec pre s e = some s') (hs : CfgOk s) : QOverlap s.cfg s'.cfg ∧ CfgOk s'

theorem cfgFold_snoc (dec : CCDec) (s : CCState) (l : List EntryM) (e : EntryM) : cfgFold dec s (l
    ++ [e]) = (cfgFold dec s l).bind fun s' => entStep dec l s' e

theorem incoming_subset_ids (c : CfgM) : c.incoming ⊆ c.ids

theorem size_diff_le (l r : GSet w64) : (l \ r).size ≤ GMap.size l

theorem gset_inter_comm (l r : GSet w64) : l ∩ r = r ∩ l

theorem cfgFoldFrom_le_one_overlap {dec : CCDec} {pre : List EntryM} {s s' : CCState} {l : List
    EntryM} (hc : confCount l ≤ 1) (h : cfgFoldFrom dec pre s l = some s') (hs : CfgOk s) : QOverlap
    s.cfg s'.cfg

theorem cfgFoldFrom_ok {dec : CCDec} {pre : List EntryM} {s s' : CCState} {l : List EntryM} (h :
    cfgFoldFrom dec pre s l = some s') (hs : CfgOk s) : CfgOk s'

theorem entStep_not_conf (dec : CCDec) (pre : List EntryM) (s : CCState) (e : EntryM) (h :
    ¬IsConfEnt e) : entStep dec pre s e = some s
